purpose: Record source completeness and authority reconciliation required before any scientific-article runtime contract is introduced.

review_basis: current UFC normalization page reviewed 2026-08-28 lists the scientific-article guide among five official guides and states that UFC guides follow current ABNT standards
official UFC scientific-article guide identifies ABNT NBR 6022:2018 as its article-presentation basis
current public university standards registries reviewed 2026-08-28 continue to identify ABNT NBR 6022:2018 and no later replacement was identified
verification.caveat: The public ABNT catalog search surface did not expose a directly indexable NBR 6022 record during automated review; the project therefore records the evidence chain instead of inventing a catalog locator.

cepe_17_2015.scope: program-level presentation directives for dissertations, theses or equivalent work
cepe_17_2015.relationship_to_cepe_17_2017: CEPE 17/2017 supplies the general ABNT/course-model normalization regime. CEPE 17/2015 supplies PPG-level institutional competence. A specific program directive must be identified and registered before it can alter runtime behavior.

mec_portaria_1224_2013.reason: MEC states that Portaria 1.224/2013 was revoked by Portaria Normativa 22/2017 and Portaria 315/2018.
